programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's trip takes him to joints serving unique eats. He tries lamb curry in Santa Fe, NM, pork belly banh mi in Reno, NV, and a mac-and-cheese waffle.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri and his son, Hunter, are taking a culinary journey up to Juneau, Alaska, and they dive into everything from a family-run, wood-fired pizza wagon making reindeer pie to a funky basement spot mashing up Latin-Asian fusion.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: In Cambridge, Mass., a joint fries up Nashville hot chicken and gangster gumbo; a smoking spot in Sparks, Nev., firing up wagyu brisket and wing nachos; in Juneau, Alaska, a fusion house is putting out smoked-brisket pho and honey-bourbon ribs.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: A transportable feast starting with red pepper and Gorgonzola bruschetta, followed by chicken salad Véronique, served with herb potato salad. For dessert is a delicious chocolate cake inspired by a family recipe.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: Miguel is documenting Ina's garden through the changing seasons on film. In return for the pictures, Ina makes him a mouthwatering lunch comprising lemon fusilli with arugula and panna cotta with balsamic strawberries.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: Ina prepares dinner and breakfast for a guest staying the night.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: Just when Jeffrey thought his birthday surprise was a romantic walk along the beach, Ina has other plans - a beach barbecue with his closest friends. On the birthday menu is a grilled butterflied chicken served with broccoli and tomato kebabs. Instead of a birthday cake, Ina creates an elegant mixed berry pavlova.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: Iced tea; grapefruit and avocado salad; lobster paella.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: It is quality time for Ina and Jeffrey as they head to the harbour and cook Scallops Provencal.

programme.title: Jamie's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a roast dinner in one pot, cutting down on washing-up but never on flavour, and rustles up his store-cupboard version of a speedy carbonara. He also shares two ways to use pre-packed ingredients to make crowd-pleasing starters or sides.

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: After fishing in Le Grau-du-Roi, Michel shares his recipe for a flavourful mackerel dish. Later, he cooks a succulent roast chicken with herb butter.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: James visits Santiago de Compostela to meet pilgrims, explore the local market, try lampreys, stop by a bakery to sample its Tarta de Santiago and take a mussel boat tour - James also cooks a seafood stew, T-bone steak, empanadas and rice with mussels.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: James visits Vigo, which is home to the biggest fish market in Europe - he tries Galician octopus, sees how a traditional Galician loaf is made, and visits a furancho while also cooking fish in mojo sauce, fish soup, a flatbread with seafood and pork in Albariño.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: Rick travels to Bamburgh and tastes some Scotch Pies. After visiting Mike Ainsley, who farms Cheviot sheep, Rick whips up a tasty moussaka, using local lamb.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: Rick and his dog Chalky are in the Yorkshire Dales. At Leyburn market, they check out the local dairy produce and, after chatting to the stall-holders, Rick prepares a Yorkshire curd tart.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: Rick visits John Firth, who rears freshwater crayfish in Galloway, and cooks crayfish with pasta. He then travels to the picturesque town of Ludlow in Shropshire, which is as rich in gastronomic delights as it is in history.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: Rick visits Cartmel in the Lake District, famous for its ancient 13th century Priory and Jean Johns' sticky toffee pudding. From her village shop in this tiny pretty village, truckloads of puddings are transported daily to all parts of Britain.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: Rick visits Cork in Southern Ireland. At the English Market, the gastronomic heart of the city, he talks to retailers and cooks corned beef and cabbage. Still in Eire, he travels up the east coast to Waterford, a town usually renowned for its glass.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: Rick is on home turf when he visits the Tintagel area in Cornwall. Here, legend has it, the ruined castle atop the craggy, untamed cliffs is what remains of King Arthur's Camelot.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: In the Clovelly area of North Devon, Rick goes fishing for herring with Steve Perham, whose family have been fishermen for over 200 years. All that fresh sea air gives them a hearty appetite as Rick fries the herring in wholemeal flour.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: Rick and Chalky travel to Loch Torridon in Scotland to go fishing with John McGregor for langoustines. Here the prawns are protected by the Marine Stewardship Council, which has awarded its seal of approval to the fishermen.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: Rick pays a memorable visit to the Channel Island of Jersey, where he goes reef fishing for sea bass, which he then grills. He also makes a consommé and enjoys a beach barbecue.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
